about: Step 6, temp book staging/touch.js (Mid's 26-input.js): every piece, and what becomes of it. in v100: already home. bring: Mid has it, v100 does not; it comes in as book entries and laws with its feature (v100's touch floor in index.html has one-finger pan, pinch, wheel zoom and a tap; menu.js the ghost and the tap's answer). cut: v100 does it another way. By the 10:31 rule, what comes over keeps Mid's values.

ptrs: index.html touch floor: ptrs, the fingers down
drag: one-finger pan and the two-finger pinch are in v100 (index.html touch floor, zoomAt); bring the drag's other modes: place, wall corner, wall slide, box, choke, crosshair
HOLD_MS: the hold 320 ms, its ring after 250 ms, the double tap 320 ms: part of the finger's rule (hold to pick more or box, double tap for the card)
holdT: the hold's timer: on one of yours, pick it and keep picking; on open ground, a box; on the crosshair, drag it
holdStop: ends the hold; with the hold
lp: the finger's point in the canvas; v100's canvas is the whole screen and reads clientX/Y
EDGE: F15: menu.js edge (the finger while it drags the ghost)
edgeScroll: F15: menu.js tick: within D206 edge px the map scrolls D206 scroll px a second
LIFT: F15: D206 lift: the ghost waits above the finger on a touch screen
ghostAt: F15: menu.js ghostTo: lifted, snapped, its reason kept
foeFirst: the toast when you order an attack on a side you are not at war with; with diplomacy (Later)
dropDrag: letting go of a drag in one place (box, crosshair glow, edge); with the hold and the crosshair
miniAt: (Albert 11:16: bring, clean) the small map's finger (tap to jump, drag to sweep); Albert's held list: see misfits
hitAt: what is under the finger: a unit first, a building by its foot or its drawn roof, a find, a resource, else the ground, never under fog; v100 has menu.js under() and the 16 px unit pick, bring the roof and the find order
cardFor: a hit to a card's type; v100's card is the subject itself, its rows picked by ticks (SN4)
lastTap: the last tap, for the double tap
tapAt: Albert's one rule for the finger (Build 40, Nov 2): a tap picks a unit, a second opens its card, a building or find opens on one tap, with units picked a tap is the order, empty ground raises the sword and x, a cut-out plot replants; v100 has menu.js FK.on('tap') (pick and send), this replaces it
ordAt: tap a marching group's ring to pick the group (26 px)
picked: the units the finger holds (many); v100 holds one (FK.sel)
pickObj: a pick's thing; with many picked
setPick: set what is picked; with many picked
pickToggle: tap adds or drops a unit while picking more; with many picked
pickSound: each shell's voice in books/shells.js (pickHoof, pickTwang, pickMetal, pickWood: Sound book HU14 and its neighbours)
order: the obvious order by tap for what is picked: attack, hunt, convert, gather, build, mend, work, walk, each villager to its own spot, the wagon's spot checked, the order's meal cost, the gold ripple; v100 has menu.js tap (gather, raise, fight, march), bring the rest
startPlace: F15: menu.js VERBS.pick: the ghost starts mid-screen snapped beside yours (D206 start); a full count or a later age dims it with the reason
cancelPlace: menu.js VERBS.close (S.ghost = null), and a second tap on the picked building
boxPick: hold and drag a box: your people in it are picked; a box of trees and nobody opens the road-cutting card

misfits: Mid has a small map you tap to jump the camera and drag to sweep it (also the radar dot a tap on the map follows, in tapAt). v100 holds the small map for later (DICTIONARY: View and Screen, Held; the War page's middle shows Map as Later). Bring Mid's small map now, or keep it held?
